name: Patriarch Metrophanes of Alexandria
role: Greek Patriarch of Alexandria from 1636 to 1639
contribution: A Greek monk and theologian who served as Greek Patriarch of Alexandria between 1636 and 1639.

checks.lead: Metrophanes Kritopoulos, sometimes Critopoulos, Critopoulus, Kritopulus (Greek: Μητροφάνης Κριτόπουλος, c. 1589 – 30 May 1639) was a Greek monk and theologian who served as Greek Patriarch of Alexandria between 1636 and 1639.
